key_points: RBC raised quarterly dividend to C$1.76 per share, signaling confidence in cash flow
Issued C$1.5 bn of fixed‑to‑floating subordinated notes due 2036 and C$1.1 bn of limited recourse capital notes due 2086
Debt issuance aligns with long‑term balance‑sheet strategy, offset by higher dividend payout
No earnings or guidance change yet; impact driven by capital‑structure news
Market likely to view the moves as neutral‑to‑positive over the coming weeks
